name: tmdb-mcp-server
description: Search movies, TV, and people on The Movie Database (TMDB) — credits, ratings, trailers, images, recommendations, and region-aware streaming availability via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

tmdb_api_key.title: TMDB API Read Access Token
tmdb_api_key.description: Required. TMDB v4 API Read Access Token (JWT), sent as 'Authorization: Bearer'. Create one at https://www.themoviedb.org/settings/api.
